predecessors.name: Portugal (Estado Novo and Third Republic)
predecessors.text: the mainland, the Azores, Madeira and Macau that remained after 'the independence of the African colonies'

ledger.x: 1976: the Third Republic's Constitution takes effect on 25 April.
1999: Portugal hands Macau back to China on 20 December.
